document.title: [Bug][Spec Decode] DSpark adaptive verification on SM90 (H20): draft acceptance collapse + hang during batch drain (sample_tokens RPC timeout)
document.body:
### Your current environment

- vLLM nightly `0.26.1rc1.dev1257+g94d96e244` (current main)
- 8x NVIDIA H20 (SM90), TP=8, single node
- model: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (deepseek_v4, UE8M0 FP8)
- --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4 --trust-remote-code --tensor-parallel-size 8
  --enable-expert-parallel --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 16384
  --max-num-seqs 256 --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.8
  --compilation-config '{"max_cudagraph_capture_size":4096}'
- --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","attention_backend":"FLASH_ATTN",
  "num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic",
  "enable_adaptive_verification":true}'


### 🐛 Describe the bug

```markdown
**Title:** [Bug][Spec Decode] DSpark adaptive verification on SM90 (H20): draft acceptance collapse + hang during batch drain (sample_tokens RPC timeout)

## Description

Found on 8x NVIDIA H20 (SM90). Reproduces on current main nightly
(`0.26.1rc1.dev1257+g94d96e244`, where #52795 is already merged, no manual
patch) and matches the behavior observed on v0.28.0 with #52795 applied by hand.

## Repro

vllm bench serve --backend openai-chat --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
  --endpoint /v1/chat/completions --model /datasets/deepseek-v4-flash-0731/ \
  --tokenizer /datasets/deepseek-v4-flash-0731/ --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4 \
  --dataset-name speed_bench --dataset-path <speedbench_dir> \
  --speed-bench-dataset-subset qualitative --speed-bench-output-len 2048 \
  --num-prompts 880 --max-concurrency 128 --request-rate inf \
  --skip-chat-template --disable-shuffle --temperature 1.0 --seed 0 --num-warmups 1

## Symptom 1 — draft acceptance collapse (present from the first step, not gradual)

SpecDecoding metrics while running:
Mean acceptance length: 1.08, Accepted throughput: 127.70 tokens/s,
Drafted throughput: 11505.48 tokens/s, Accepted: 1277 tokens, Drafted: 115052 tokens,
Per-position acceptance rate: 0.070, 0.006, 0.001, 0.000, 0.000, 0.000, 0.000,
Avg Draft acceptance rate: 1.1%

Later window:
Mean acceptance length: 1.04, Accepted: 417, Drafted: 80290,
Per-position acceptance rate: 0.034, 0.002, 0.000, ...,
Avg Draft acceptance rate: 0.5%

Draft is produced at full length (Drafted ~8-11k tok/s) but almost entirely
rejected (Accepted ~40-128 tok/s).

## Symptom 2 — deterministic hang during batch drain

Engine hangs when the in-flight batch drains to ~88-127 requests (generation
throughput drops to 0), then after ~5 minutes dies with:

TimeoutError: RPC call to sample_tokens timed out.

preceded by repeated:

No available shared memory broadcast block found in 60 seconds.

No CUDA error is raised; workers never reply. The auto-dump shows a healthy
SchedulerOutput (each request scheduled 8 tokens,
num_spec_tokens_to_schedule=7, spec placeholders [-1]*7).

## Single-variable A/B (only enable_adaptive_verification toggled)

- false -> all 880 requests complete; Mean acceptance length 2.7, per-position
  acceptance 0.704 / 0.448 / 0.275 / 0.154 / 0.083 / 0.043 / 0.020; no hang.
- true -> both symptoms above.

Note: with next_n=8 on SM90 the flattened decode path and CUDA-graph ALWAYS
support are already exercised in the non-adaptive case, so the failure isolates
to the adaptive device-side draft-budget / decode-length path.


## Related issues checked (all distinct from this one)

- #51303 (adaptive DSpark bring-up tracker)
- #51593 / #51538 (negative context length -> persistent_topk deadlock; fixed for the native path only)
- #51970 / #51972 (SM90 indexer metadata OOB on all-zero lengths; clamp did not help here)
- #52785 / #52783 (SM100 GLM varlen adaptive; different arch/model)
```


### Before submitting a new issue...

- [x] Make sure you already searched for relevant issues, and asked the chatbot living at the bottom right corner of the [documentation page](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/), which can answer lots of frequently asked questions.
